grounding.states: TSX closed today, Monday Oct 12, for Thanksgiving; trading resumes Tuesday Oct 13
grounding.from: TMX Group said the Toronto Stock Exchange, TSX Venture Exchange, TSX Alpha Exchange and Montréal Exchange are closed Monday, October 12, 2026 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Regular trading resumes Tuesday, October 13.

grounding.states: last close, Friday Oct 9: S&P/TSX composite at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (about 1.48%)
grounding.from: The S&P/TSX composite index was up 519.24 points at 35,664.62 (BNN Bloomberg/Canadian Press). That is a gain of about 1.48%.

value.answer: The TSX is closed today for Thanksgiving, back open Tuesday. Last time it traded, Friday, it closed at 35,664.62, up about 1.5% on the day.
